name: Make money buying and selling things online
description: Buy and sell goods for a profit. The environment supplies its own score — money — which makes success objective, but it is not fixed the way a game opponent is: the world changes underneath, so a score from last year is not comparable with one from today.
notes: Open question for this task: how to define a stationary evaluation when the environment itself drifts. Likely needs a recorded, replayable market period as the frozen scorer.
